papers.title_en: SAMV-DUSt3R: Instance-Centric 3D Scene Decoupling from Sparse Multi-Views
papers.authors: Langxu Zhao, Zuan Gu, Yingdan Zhang, Pengfei Zhao, Tianhan Gao
papers.evidence: 注入SAM2二维掩码实现实例级物体解耦
papers.tldr: 从稀疏多视角三维场景中解耦目标实例的需求持续上升，但现有方法常依赖多阶段流程，难以兼顾重建精度与对象级分离。SAMV-DUSt3R将SAM2二维掩码注入MV-DUSt3R重建，以端到端方式实现实例中心的三维场景解耦。其Cross Flow Mask Block利用掩码引导网络聚焦目标实例，Spatial RankGNN则以73.5%准确率选择最佳参考视角以稳定重建。实验表明，多指标平均重建精度较当前最优基线提升11%，并展现强实例解耦能力，可服务驾驶、机器人、AR/VR与遗产数字化等应用。
papers.abstract_en: With the rising demand to decouple objects from 3D scenes, we propose SAMV-DUSt3R, an end-to-end model that injects SAM2 2D masks into MV-DUSt3R reconstruction. A Cross Flow Mask Block uses these masks to steer the network toward the target instance, jointly improving shape accuracy and achieving object-level disentanglement without multi-stage pipelines. To ensure reconstruction stability, a lightweight Spatial RankGNN selects the optimal reference view with a selection accuracy of 73.5\%. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method boosts average reconstruction precision by 11\% across various metrics compared to state-of-the-art baselines. These results reveal a strong instance-disentanglement capability and clear benefits for driving, robotics, AR/VR, and heritage digitisation.
